specialRequests.description: The requests for the hotel, as given when ordering; null when none were given. Not guaranteed.

asOf.description: When these terms were read: status and penalties are as of this time.

cancellation.description: The cancellation terms the order was made on, as read then; cancel says what can be done now.

mode.description: instant: the hotel confirms the booking as soon as it is made. on_request: the hotel confirms or refuses it later, within withinMinutes when stated. unknown: not stated.

withinMinutes.description: For on_request, the minutes the hotel takes to confirm; null when instant or not stated.

anyOf.description: How the hotel confirms a booking of this offer.

confirmation.description: How the hotel confirms the booking, as the order's offer gave it; null when not on record.

payAtProperty.description: Fees paid at the property, on top of price.total, in the property's currency, not converted. disclosure incomplete: there may be fees not listed.

total.description: The whole stay for all rooms: what paying charges, or once paid what was charged. In USD or CNY, the currency of the offer the order was made from; an order made on the Fortrip website may be in another currency. Fees payable at the property are not in it.

url.description: The payment page, on fortrip.ai; it continues to the payment provider. With requiresSignIn false anyone holding it can pay; with requiresSignIn true (an order started on the Fortrip website) it continues to the Fortrip booking page, where only the signed-in owner can pay. null while a payment is held (authorized) or when the order isn't awaiting payment, or, while it is and its payment is unpaid, while a payment is being processed: read the order again shortly, and don't give an earlier link.

expiresAt.description: When the time to pay ends: an order unpaid by then expires, with nothing charged. null unless status is awaiting_payment.

localCurrencyAtCheckout.description: Whether paying by url may charge the card in its own currency, converted by Stripe; false once paid by token, or by Alipay or WeChat Pay on the payment page; always false on a CNY order.

localCharge.description: What the card was charged in its own currency, when Stripe converted the total; otherwise null. Always null on a CNY order.

handler.description: The com.stripe.payments handler, which takes the token.

max_amount.description: The order's total in the currency's minor unit (cents for usd); a token that allows less can't pay.

currency.description: The token's currency, lowercase as Stripe takes it: usd.

expires_at.description: When the order's time to pay ends, in Unix seconds; the order can't be paid after it.

usageLimits.description: Stripe's usage limits for the token: copy these values as they are into the token request.

token.description: What to request a Stripe shared payment token with, for pay_order. null when no token can pay this order: a CNY order, an order from the Fortrip website's own checkout, a total over $500, or when none can be taken now (too little time left to pay, the order's limit of tokens reached, or a payment open on its payment page); then the user pays by url.

action.description: cancel: a paid order that can be cancelled now under its terms, keeping penalty and returning refund; cancel_order takes maximumPenalty. close: an unpaid order that can be closed, with nothing charged; cancel_order takes close: true. null: neither applies, and blockedBy says why.

blockedBy.description: Why the order can be neither cancelled nor closed now; null when action is set. payment_in_progress: unpaid, a payment is under way. website_checkout: unpaid, on the Fortrip website's own checkout, where it expires unpaid. expired, failed: nothing is booked. confirming: the booking is still with the hotel. cancelling: a cancellation is under way. already_cancelled. stay_started. non_refundable: the rate can't be cancelled. refused: the hotel refused a cancellation and the booking stands. terms_unknown: the cancellation terms are not on record. needs_attention: a person at Fortrip has to resolve it.

penalty.description: What a cancellation now keeps, under the accepted terms, in the total's currency; past the free deadline it can be the whole total. null unless action is cancel.

refund.description: What a cancellation now returns: what was paid less the penalty, in the total's currency; 0 when the penalty is the whole total. null unless action is cancel.

cancel.description: What cancel_order can do to the order now: cancel it for a penalty and a refund, close it, or neither.

penalty.description: What the cancellation kept, in the total's currency.

refund.description: What the cancellation returned; payment.status says whether it has been.

cancelled.description: What a cancellation kept and returned. null unless status is cancelled, and on a cancelled order whose figures are not on record.

reason.description: sold_out: the room sold out before it was booked. hotel_refused: the hotel refused the booking. details_refused: the booking was refused for the guest or contact details given. unknown: not on record.

failure.description: Why no stay was booked. null unless status is failed.

nextCursor.description: Pass it back as cursor for the next page; null on the last page.

nextStep.description: What to show and ask before giving a payment.url. Present when the answer holds a non-null payment.url, and only then.

status.description: awaiting_payment: not paid yet (a payment just made may still be settling); payable until payment.expiresAt. expired: not paid; the time ran out or the order was closed. matched.description: Hotels that match the destination, the text and every filter but the price filter.

priced.description: Hotels priced: those on this page, or with a price sort or price filter the whole priced set (pricing.scope); null without prices.

withPrice.description: Of those priced, how many have an indicative price; null when prices weren't asked for or are unavailable.

poolRadiusMeters.description: When a price sort or price filter priced only the nearest 3,000: how far the farthest of them is from the center, in meters; otherwise null.

excludedNoPrice.description: With a price filter: priced hotels left out for having no indicative price; otherwise null.

excludedNoFacilityData.description: With an amenity filter: hotels left out for listing no facilities at all, though they may have the amenity; otherwise null.

withinMaxRadius.description: For a radius under 80,000 m: how many would match within 80,000 m of the center; otherwise null.

textAnywhere.description: With text and a place: the hotels that match the text anywhere in the place's country; otherwise null.

localities.description: For an area: its top localities, the towns its matching hotels belong to; otherwise null.

nameAsText.description: When a place_name search matched few hotels: how many in its country match the name as text; otherwise null.

coverage.description: What the search covered: counts of hotels, each null when it doesn't apply.

currencyHint.description: Present only when the search is not in that currency and the user may pay through its channel: this request comes from mainland China (request_location), or the user's latest sign-in to Fortrip was there (sign_in_location). Prices are also available in that currency; a suggestion, not a requirement.

photo.description: The cover photo; null when there is none.
